findings.text: the landed change appends its own 'reckon crew watch: producer ... exited at start' line after the 'reckon crew watch stopped: producer crashed repeatedly' line dispatch_watch.py still writes at the restart limit, and _logged_producer_stop reads only the last non-blank line and returns None unless it carries the 'stopped: ' marker, so a producer whose start fails now yields no stop reason at crew_follow_commands.py:2359 where the base reported one, and the follower pane falls silent on a silent fleet; the news reaches a reader only through the new obligations duty and the launch warning.

the done_when's fourth fact asks for a launch's record saying no producer was armed, but test_a_launch_while_the_start_fails_is_admitted asserts producer_armed on the dict _ensure_watch_producer returns and on the warning string and never on the pointer record a launch writes, so a caller that dropped watch_state's producer_armed key from record['watch'] would leave this file green.
